linear_operator_analysis.scope: Exact equivalence for complete unweighted pairwise linear secants with matched event groups, features and regularization. Does not cover arbitrary pair weights, learned nonlinear edit grammars, or establish a general impossibility of transferable experimentation.

interpretation: Independent fresh-environment attempts confirm ordinary continuous optimizers can solve tasks beyond literal candidate replay. CMA-ES solves catapult seed303 and parcel seed303; RBF BO solves catapult seeds300 and303. Both are 2/8, object-prior random search is 0/8. This is a small development comparison with one optimizer seed per task, not superiority evidence for a new method or a reproduction of HExA/Causal-PIK.
operator_boundary: For complete unweighted within-event pairs, linear secant least squares is exactly centered multivariate ridge regression at lambda/n. Independent code checks on 49 groups yield coefficient differences below 8e-14 and inverse proposals below 1.8e-13. Routing and representation are matched, not ablated. The claim does not cover other non-linear program construction mechanisms.
reset_correction: v0 reused native reset_attempt, which preserves Box2D warm-start state. Its four successes reproduce in fresh environments, but some trajectories differ. v1 creates a fresh environment per query and supersedes v0 for standalone attempt comparisons. v1 parity matches success and step count on all six selected replay checks.
source_and_target: No offline source training used in these continuous comparators. Each task gets the same five initial target proposals, charged to its 25-query budget. Cross-task transfer and new-method gain remain untested.

interaction_accounting.note: An assertion-stopped check executed 1–6 queries before losing in-memory records; one failed-serialization follow-up executed one. Their exact count is not asserted. Verification replays are not additional independent tasks.

decision: Retire the specified linear event-secant candidate as a novel learning rule; it has an exact ordinary-regression implementation. Do not expand task counts or run long GPU work for it. Retain the continuous native comparator harness for a substantively different learning operation.
